milestone: Owned envelopes, selective receive, parking/wakeup and waiting-state cleanup
machine_constraint: User actively uses this machine for other work. NEVER run speed tests or performance comparisons here; prior local timings are unsuitable performance indicators.
controls: Each compiler profile: 21 deterministic protocol/ownership tests; three public mailbox-control invocations; 66 compile-rejected consumers and three positive shadowing routes.
logical_oracles: Earliest matching order, retained nonmatches, one unit per candidate, peer completion event before scanner completion, peer event during nine cleanup batches, no idle polling, exact release counts and stale-incarnation isolation.
races: 16 bounded send/kill races per public invocation, plus two host publishers with eight messages each; receipt/ownership assertions only.
timing_policy: No sampled timings, rates, warmups, affinity changes or performance summaries. Watchdog timeouts detect hangs only; incidental cargo test/build duration text is not analyzed as evidence.
limits: fixed scalar tag or any selector
trusted host allocator and panic behavior
